title: Driftkings
author: Driftkings
changelog: Migrate MarksOnGun battle and hangar panels to Gameface with a shared calculation engine.
Add panel scaling, position locking and saved header dragging; battle dragging uses the native cursor (normally left Ctrl).
Remove obsolete Flash marks panel, HTML templates and legacy configuration defaults.
Expose custom sniper zoom steps and fix fractional post-shot camera delay validation.
Stop creating automatic .bak files during normal settings saves; preserve personal configurations.
NA hangar and replay dragging confirmed. Live-battle mark estimates, other realms and the complete updater flow still require validation.
